@codygunton boundary note for #217 (branch `agent/shipped-pipeline`, @kevaundray's agent), touching the default `lean-link` path you own the compiler of:

- **No change** to any `FV/E2E/DeadCleanup*`, `FV/Link/DeadCleanup*` or Stock file, statement or proof. New files only compose them: `FV/E2E/DeadCleanupExecPeak.lean` (peak-depth wrappers over the generic `backend_correct_program_peakX`, a `sysSK` with any callee budget), `FV/Link/DeadCleanupExePeak.lean`, `FV/Link/DeadCleanupExeSource.lean`, `FV/Link/NonVacuityDeadCleanupExeSource.lean` → `Link.DeadCleanup.compileExe_correct_peak`, `_source`, `_source_peak`; witnesses in `crate-proofs/Crates/DeadCleanupExe{Peak,Source}Witness.lean`.
- CLI, additive/opt-in: `lake exe lean-link … --verified` (and `cargo fv --lean-link --verified`, own target dir) fails closed outside `SrcScopeB`/`InScopeP`; default (`--dead-cleanup`, fallback to `DeadCleanup.leanLink`) unchanged, it only prints one extra `coverage:` line naming the theorems (also `binary.lean_link` in the report). `SrcScopeB`'s definitions moved from `FV/E2E/LegalSource.lean` to a proof-free `FV/E2E/SrcScopeDefs.lean` so the exe can decide it.
